evaluation_context.agent_environment: Google Anti-Gravity / Gemini 3.8 Flash (Middle reasoning effort)

c5_opaque_worker_enforcement.minimal_boundary_definition: Process tree containment with chroot/bind-mount filesystem namespace isolating scratch fixtures, read-only system mounts, and seccomp-bpf syscall filtering.
host_capabilities_required: Active sandbox daemon socket or seccomp syscall filtering

antigravity_sandbox_mode.error: connecting to sandbox server: read unix @->@: recvmsg: connection reset by peer
antigravity_sandbox_mode.root_cause: Current execution environment is an unprivileged container lacking the nested daemon or kernel namespace permissions required by the Antigravity sandbox daemon.

c5_opaque_worker_enforcement.external_supervisor_feasibility: Infeasible on current host without elevated host privileges (CAP_SYS_ADMIN) or container socket access.

c7_network_policy_enforcement.minimal_boundary_definition: Kernel-level network namespace isolation (CLONE_NEWNET) with loopback only, or iptables/nftables egress packet drop anchored to worker cgroup/UID.
c7_network_policy_enforcement.application_vs_kernel_distinction: Application-level tool rejection or prompt-based instructions ('do not use network') are non-enforcing against opaque worker shell execution. C7 strictly requires kernel-level packet isolation.
host_capabilities_required: CAP_NET_ADMIN or unprivileged user network namespace (CLONE_NEWUSER | CLONE_NEWNET)
c7_network_policy_enforcement.host_reality: Current container environment lacks CAP_NET_ADMIN and unprivileged network namespace creation.

c8_trial_identity_binding.evaluator_ownership_requirement: Witness must be produced and cryptographically bound by an independent evaluator supervisor outside worker process control.
c8_trial_identity_binding.blocker: Cannot truthfully assert 'opaque_worker_code: enforced' or 'network_policy: enforced' while C5 and C7 are NOT_ESTABLISHED.

architectural_placement_analysis.policy_template_scope: Application-neutral policy definition, validation rules, and instruction delivery formats (ADR 0003, ADR 0005).
architectural_placement_analysis.enforcement_subsystem_scope: OS-level virtualization, container isolation, kernel network filtering, and cryptographic supervisor attestation.
architectural_placement_analysis.boundary_finding: Low-level OS virtualization and kernel sandboxing do not belong in the policy template. Embedding them would violate ADR 0003, create untenable Linux-specific maintenance overhead, and couple policy specifications to host infrastructure.

options.name: DEFER_ENFORCEMENT_INVESTMENT
options.scope: Preserve current NOT_ESTABLISHED classification; maintain zero trial execution under stopping rule; defer enforcement tooling.
options.security_posture: Sound. No un-isolated code executed; no false compliance claims.
options.time_to_first_valid_trial: Indefinite (no trials run until execution platform provides certified boundary).
options.architectural_cleanliness: High. Policy repository remains clean and focused on policy logic.

options.name: INVEST_MINIMAL_BOUNDARY
options.scope: Attempt to construct a minimal custom sandbox and netns supervisor within the policy repository.
options.maintenance_cost: High. Requires maintaining fragile Linux namespace, seccomp, and netns wrapper scripts.
options.operational_complexity: High. Blocked by current container environment; requires root/privileged host reconfiguration.
options.security_posture: Moderate to Low. Custom minimal boundaries frequently suffer sandbox escape vectors.
options.time_to_first_valid_trial: 2 to 4 weeks (requires environment migration and sandbox debugging).
options.architectural_cleanliness: Poor. Pollutes policy template with OS-level virtualization infrastructure.

options.name: SEPARATE_GENERAL_PLATFORM_PROJECT
options.scope: Design and build a reusable, general-purpose agent execution sandbox and supervisor in a dedicated infrastructure project.
options.maintenance_cost: Moderate (amortized across multiple agent projects and templates).
options.security_posture: High. Dedicated testbed architecture with VM/microVM (e.g. Firecracker/gVisor) isolation.
options.architectural_cleanliness: High. Complete separation of policy authoring from runtime execution infrastructure.

rationale: 1. Host Infeasibility: The current container execution environment cannot support kernel namespaces, bwrap, or Antigravity sandbox daemon without privileged host changes.
2. Architectural Integrity: Embedding OS sandboxing inside the policy template violates ADR 0003 and ADR 0005. Sandboxing belongs in a separate infrastructure layer.
3. Scientific Integrity: Preserving NOT_ESTABLISHED maintains 100% empirical rigor. No trials are run under un-isolated conditions.
4. Operational Economy: Avoids spending significant engineering resources on a one-off experiment when delivery adoption is not required.
revisit_conditions: Provisioning of a certified execution platform with kernel-level container/VM sandboxing and network isolation.
Establishment of an independent runner/testbed platform project providing policy-worker-boundary-v1 attestation.
authoritative_recommendation.next_safe_action: Preserve NOT_ESTABLISHED. Keep full-text agents-md as the default renderer. Close active delivery experiment phase.
